title: Nice loveseat, just Not comfy
text: Nice loveseat, just Not comfy. Loveseat is really packaged nicely in one box. It all fits together using a track in track system unlike most online loveseats using a bolt to hold the arms on. Seems pretty sturdy. Im 6ft about 270lbs it holds no issues and comfort wise i expected better from a memory foam company. Its pretty hard and i doubt it breaks in to be super comfortable. I took off two stars for the lack of comfort. But otherwsie i think it will last awhile.

product_metadata.title: ZINUS Jackie Sofa Couch / Easy, Tool-Free Assembly, Beige
features: Polyester Fabric With Foam and Fiber Cushions
SIMPLICITY AT ITS BEST - Go minimalist with this classic silhouette, complete with a no-fuss woven fabric and supportive seat, it just about begs to be your new favorite nap spot

BUILT TO LAST - A naturally strong frame is wrapped in supportive foam cushioning and durable woven fabric; seats a maximum weight capacity of 750 lbs; seat cushions are secured to the frame and are not detachable, while back cushions are detachable
DIMENSIONS: 70.87" L x 31.1" W x 34.65" H | WEIGHT: 85.42 lbs
TOOL FREE ASSEMBLY - All parts and instructions are cleverly packed into one box for easy assembly in less than 20 minutes
EASY CARE - Cushions are easily cleaned with a clean, damp cloth and mild detergent; cushion covers are not removable
Included components: Seat Cushion, Backrest, Armrest, Backrest Pillow
description: When it comes to furniture, comfort is one element that never goes out of style. Find a seating choice that’s as easy going as it is charming in our Jackie Sofa. Designed with durable materials like its firm and supportive foam cushioning and polyester fabric upholstery, this three-seater has an appeal that fits in just about any setting, be it minimalist, contemporary, traditional or somewhere in between. Subtle details like its flared arms and tapered legs make it easy to love and even easier to personalize with your favorite throw or accent pillows. The Jackie comes packed and ready with two wins included our one year worry-free warranty and under-20-minute setup that’s tool-free and (even better) hassle-free. Trust us, choosing this affordable, comfy-chic sofa is one of the better decisions you’ll make this year.
